embed.global.js is dist/embed.global.js from the npm package @polar-sh/checkout 0.4.1, unchanged.
Licence: Apache-2.0, the text is in LICENSE.txt. Source: https://github.com/polarsource/polar.git (clients/packages/checkout).
It is served from this site, not from a CDN. It only opens Polar's checkout page in a frame when a visitor
presses a Buy button. Update it with: node tools/vendor-polar-embed.mjs <version>
